statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
Continuous remote monitoring is clinically necessary to detect symptomatic arrhythmias and guide management
